description.value: The Cowichan Regional Visitor Centre is operated by the Duncan Cowichan Chamber of Commerce and serves as the primary tourism information hub for the Cowichan Valley region. Staffed by accredited travel counsellors, it helps visitors discover local experiences including hiking, biking, kayaking, whale-watching, and the Cowichan wine trail. Located on the Trans-Canada Highway adjacent to the BC Forest Discovery Centre, it also stocks local artisanal products and regional merchandise.

enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number also available: 1-888-303-3337. Visitor Services contact is Kirsty Grant (visitorinfo@duncancc.bc.ca). Shared entrance and parking with BC Forest Discovery Centre.
